meta.name: git
meta.description:
Git and code hosting platform management — GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Forgejo.
Zero barrier — install x-cmd and manage repos from the terminal.
Use for "git", "github", "gitlab", "repo", "pull request", "code hosting".

copy.tagline: 在终端管理代码仓库和拉取请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常用 Git 和 GitHub 管理代码仓库
copy.tagline_en: Manage repos and pull requests from the terminal
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Git repos and GitHub pull requests

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过终端命令管理 Git 仓库和代码托管平台（如 GitHub、GitLab、Codeberg、Forgejo），包括查看仓库列表、克隆仓库、创建拉取请求等。
howto.when: 当用户提到“git”、“github”、“gitlab”、“repo”、“pull request”或“代码托管”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我列出我的 GitHub 仓库。
say.note: Claude 会执行 x gh repo list 命令。

say.text: 创建一个拉取请求，标题为“修复 bug”。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Git repos and code hosting platforms (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Forgejo) via terminal commands, including listing repos, cloning repos, and creating pull requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "git", "github", "gitlab", "repo", "pull request", or "code hosting".

say_en.note: Claude will run x gh repo list.
Claude will run x gh repo clone owner/repo.

say_en.text: Create a pull request with title "Fix bug".
say_en.note: Claude will run x gh pr create --title "Fix bug".
